title: Trust sandbox diary - SOC2 prep ramble
content:
Purpose:
- Free-form scratchpad for mapping product features to SOC2 evidence. Not a final artifact — this is my playground for hypotheses and quick evidence hacks.

Top-level goal:
- Produce a minimal, repeatable evidence bundle for a scoping audit covering Hosted API + Dedicated + Private for the last 12 months.

Quick hypotheses (what auditors will want):
- Logical access: RBAC + SSO + admin separation are primary. Need screenshots of Console roles, recent IAM exports, and a demo of a role-change workflow.
- Change mgmt: GitHub PR -> CI -> deploy logs with approvals. Need a short chain for 3 representative releases (one hotfix, one feature, one canary).
- Incident response: show pager duty run, postmortem, and evidence of communication. Pick a low-risk incident (token rotation) as example.
- Data protection: KMS key rotation and HSM integration for Private. Provide KMS audit logs and a note on encryption-in-transit config for VPC.

Control mapping sketches (rough):
- CC6 (Change mgmt): GH PR ids + CI run ids + rollout logs from Console. Evidence: PR 410 (linked), CircleCI build-IDs, canary metric screenshot. Owner: Jordan.
- CC7 (Logical access): SSO SAML config export, list of Console admin users, timestamped IAM audit log. Evidence: SAML metadata, iam-export-2026-01-12.csv. Owner: Maya.
- CC8 (Incident mgmt): PD incident 2025-11-17 (token-leak-precaution), postmortem doc, communication log (Slack #sec-ops thread). Owner: Ellie.
- CC3 (System ops & monitoring): observability retention policy, latency error dashboard screenshots, trace of a degraded rollout. Evidence: dashboard-per-route-2026-02.png, trace-req-83421. Owner: me (Kaito).

Open questions / unknowns:
- Private deployment evidence: we need proof of on-prem customer audit logs — do we have canned export scripts for customers? Who owns them?
- Dedicated commitments: auditors may ask for capacity planning docs & SLA contracts. Finance/legal copy? Add to linked artifacts.
- Are KV cache/eval caching considered a control for data retention? Might be edge-case — ask legal.

Low-effort wins (do first):
- Export Console role list + capture a short screencap of role creation flow. (15–30m)
- Pull the three representative deploys and attach PR -> CI -> Console rollout timeline. (1–2h)
- Collect the KMS rotation schedule and attach last rotation statement. (30m)

Evidence collection checklist (draft):
- [ ] RBAC snapshot (CSV) + screenshot (Maya)
- [ ] SSO metadata + IdP config (Jordan)
- [ ] Three deploy chains with approvals + build logs (Jordan)
- [ ] One incident postmortem with timeline and comms (Ellie)
- [ ] KMS rotation logs and policy doc (me)
- [ ] Private deployment: example on-prem evidence export + customer consent note (Legal)
- [ ] SLA / Dedicated contract extract (Finance)

Notes to self (random):
- Keep everything TTLed to 12 months for scope simplicity.
- Avoid over-collecting PII from logs — strip request bodies when capturing traces.
- For evidentiary screenshots, include timestamps and username overlays where possible.

Short script ideas for automation (follow-up):
- small python: /scripts/evidence-pull.py 
  - endpoints: console-api -> roles export, jobs-api -> deploy history, kms-api -> rotation history
  - output: zip with csvs + md manifest (owner/date/notes)

Meeting agenda to align owners (send Thurs 10am):
1) Quick walk through control map (15m)
2) Assign evidence owners and target dates (10m)
3) Decide scope (12 months? hosted+deds+one private?) (10m)
4) Next steps / automation owners (5m)

Backlog items (nice-to-have):
- Formalize an evidence manifest template (md) for auditors.
- Add a small demo export in private-deploy that shows on-prem logs sanitized.
- Draft an exec 1-pager on SOC2 readiness for sales.

Random brainstorming: how Redwood product specifics map to SOC2 talking points:
- Model rollout & fallback policies: show they are safety & availability controls — include canary metrics & automatic fallback event logs.
- Batching/caching: document they are performance optimizations, but ensure cache invalidation is covered in change mgmt.
- Routing & fallbacks: include routing policy config as part of availability evidence (policy snapshots).

Next immediate actions (today):
- DM Maya to ask for RBAC export.
- Create GH issue skeleton for evidence automation and assign to infra intern.
- Draft meeting invite for Thu.

-- end scratchpad --

(If this doc becomes useful, migrate cleaned mapping to shared_drives/company/trust ops later.)
